tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring drone (quadcopter) on a plane?

travelTips: Remove drone batteries and pack them in your carry-on bag.

faq.question: Is drone (quadcopter) allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Drone (Quadcopter) is allowed in carry-on luggage. Drones themselves are allowed in carry-on and checked luggage. However, their lithium-ion batteries are strictly restricted to carry-on baggage only.

faq.question: Can you pack drone (quadcopter) in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Drone (Quadcopter) is restricted in checked bags.
